exposure: Induction of labor at 39 weeks gestation
cohort: The study participants were primiparous women with singleton pregnancies and no risk factors, with a gestational age between 38 weeks 0 days and 38 weeks six days at the time of recruitment.
finding: No significant difference was observed in the frequencies of caesarean section, fetal, neonatal, and maternal outcomes between primiparous women induced at 39 weeks and those managed conventionally.
mod_finding: The frequency of caesarean section was not statistically significant between the group induced at 39 weeks (6.1%) and the conventionally managed group (2.4%).
gest_age: Participants were between 38 weeks 0 days and 38 weeks six days at recruitment, with induction at 39 weeks for the intervention group.
